facts.text: Founded in 1869, Claflin University is South Carolina's first and oldest historically Black college or university.

sources.title: Claflin University Earns a No. 10 Spot
sources.quote: Founded in 1869, Claflin University is South Carolina's first and oldest HBCU.

facts.text: Founded in 1869 and named for Lee Claflin, Claflin University was the first South Carolina institution open to all regardless of race.

sources.title: History — A Legacy of Firsts Since 1869 - Claflin University
